mapper.sql: s.id, s.student_no, s.real_name, s.gender, s.phone, s.email, s.class_id, s.department_id, s.user_id, u.status, s.create_time, s.update_time, s.deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM student s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT , ci.class_name as className, d.dept_name as departmentName FROM student s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN class_info ci ON s.class_id = ci.id LEFT JOIN department d ON s.department_id = d.id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (student_no, real_name, gender, phone, email, class_id, department_id, user_id) VALUES (#{studentNo}, #{realName}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{classId}, #{departmentId}, #{userId})
